sourceChecks.text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
sourceChecks.reasonJa: WEB4:21 names Er in Shelah’s Judahite line and calls him father of Lecah; WEB2:3 separately names Judah’s firstborn Er. Wikipedia’s list entry explicitly distinguishes the 4:21 descendant.
